abstract.text: Regions divide a Project into broad areas. Layers describe levels or surfaces inside a Region, such as floors in a building.

inlineContent.text: Assign Locations to a Region and Layer when this helps your team find them. On the Map, the Layer selector appears when the center of the view is inside a Layer area. Use Project details to manage Regions and Layers.

abstract.text: Learn how to organize places and work in LinkMap on iOS and the web.
A Project brings together the places and activities for one area or shared effort.
